name: Kiyokawa Shinobu
source:
A classmate of the protagonist.
An extremely uptight, serious girl.
She keeps the PC Gaming Club, full of eccentric members, in check.

After hearing that she was writing a novel, the protagonist scouted her to write the scenario.

Her family runs a dojo, so her specialty is iaido. Perhaps because of this, people around her find her a little intimidating.

She secretly adores the protagonist, who treats her like an ordinary person, regardless of what others think.
